scripts.test: for f in server.js src/database/db.js src/routes/*.js src/controllers/*.js src/middleware/*.js src/services/*.js src/models/*.js src/validators/*.js src/scripts/*.js; do node --check "$f" || exit 1; done
scripts.db:init: node -e "require('dotenv').config(); const fs=require('fs'); const {query,pool}=require('./src/database/db'); query(fs.readFileSync('src/database/schema.sql','utf8')).then(()=>{console.log('Database schema initialized'); return pool.end();}).catch(error=>{console.error(error); process.exitCode=1; return pool.end();})"
